CommunityApplications.Profile: Unraid templates from Richardson Resources (https://www.richardsonresources.com): Docker applications, and in future plugins, that we build and maintain. The first is No Fixed Address, self-hosted dynamic DNS for Cloudflare: a small container that keeps your DNS records pointed at your server's current public IP address, with no third-party account to renew. Each template links to its own project page and issue tracker, which is the place for help with that app. For a problem with a template itself, open an issue at https://github.com/mdr6273/unraid-apps/issues.
